text:
sam_peopleops: Quick sync — Tony (new hire) Day 1 onboarding plan. Need to confirm I-9 in-person timing, BG intake status, laptop pickup/shipping, badge escort, and the short orientation timeline. Who can own which piece?

alex_hr: I can own I-9 + BG intake coordination. GoodHire sent the background email but Tony hasn’t completed one section yet. For I-9 we need physical docs verified by an authorized reviewer — can be onsite or via an approved notary agent.

maria_it: I’ll provision a laptop and MDM. Preference? We usually ship a MacBook Air M2 or prepare a spares Dell XPS for office pickup. If shipping, need a shipping address + signed device waiver from the hire.

ton y_newhire: Tony_newhire: I’ll be onsite Mon morning (hybrid). Shipping isn’t necessary. Quick Q — my passport renewal is pending, can I use my CA driver’s license + SS card for I-9?

alex_hr: Yes Tony — DL + SS card is fine for List A/B combination. If passport works better later we can reverify but DL+SS is standard. Please upload a photo of DL to the portal beforehand so we can pre-check.

sam_peopleops: facilities / rachel_security — can someone meet Tony at 09:15 for badge escort and desk orientation? Also we need a brief workstation setup slot (15–20m) for IT pairing and MFA enrollment.

facilities: I’ll schedule an escort and reserve Desk 4B. 09:15 works. Also confirm whether Tony needs a parking pass.

rachel_security: Badge ready, will meet at lobby with escort. Bring a photo ID for badge pickup (we’ll use the same ID for the I-9 verification).

maria_it: Planning to image the laptop with MDM + emulator hooks. ETA to get laptop staged: Friday EOD if we get confirmation today. Command I’ll run: `./stage_device --asset TonyN --profile onboarding-v2`

sam_peopleops: Tony — can you finish the GoodHire section and upload your DL pic by EOD Thu? HR needs 48h to finalize BG intake per vendor SLA. Also fill the short catering/preferences form so we can order lunch. Link: https://forms.redwood/welcome-lunch

ton y_newhire: Will do — finish GoodHire today and upload DL pic. Lunch: vegetarian + gluten-free. Thanks!

hr-bot: Reminder: New-hire packet incomplete — 3 items remaining. Deadline: 48 hours before start.

alex_hr: Once BG is green and I-9 verified, I’ll send the benefits welcome packet and schedule the 1:1 HR intro at 10:30. That meeting covers benefits enrollment timelines and whom to contact for 401(k).

sam_peopleops: Final checklist for owners: alex_hr -> I-9 & BG verification; maria_it -> laptop staging & MDM; facilities -> escort + desk; rachel_security -> badge; sam_peopleops -> orientation runbook + lunch order. Post any blockers here. :white_check_mark:

facilities: Parking pass added to Tony’s profile.

maria_it: Laptop imaged and labeled TonyN-2027 in asset list. MDM invite sent to Tony email.

alex_hr: BG status changed to "Pending final verification" — I’ll update when fully clear.

ton y_newhire: All set on my side — GoodHire complete and DL uploaded. See you Monday. :smile:

sam_peopleops: Great — closing loop. If anything unexpected pops up, please @sam_peopleops in this thread.
